title: The new girl is very cute!
grammar: Use of adjectives; Intensifier very; Verb be: information questions with What color; Questions with or
vocab_topic: Adjectives to describe people; Adjectives to describe eyes and hair
pair_game: Say a word. Your partner points at a picture or a person in the class. Then swap!

grammar_box.title: Adjectives and very
grammar_box.tip: Adjective + noun: a tall boy, NOT a boy tall (sifat oldin keladi)

questions: Describe yourself — what do you look like? What color is your hair and eyes?
Who is the tallest person in your family? Describe them.
Describe your best friend. What does he or she look like?
What color are your eyes? Are they very dark or light?
Describe your favorite teacher. What do they look like?
Are you tall or short? Is that okay with you or do you want to be different?
Describe someone in your class using adjectives. Don't say their name!
What do you think is the most important — how someone looks or how they act?
Describe a famous person you think is very good-looking.
Is your hair straight or curly? Long or short? Do you like your hair?
starters: I’m … . My hair is … and my eyes are … .
The tallest person is my … . He/She is very … .
My best friend is … . He/She has … hair and … eyes.
My eyes are … . They are very … .
My favourite teacher is … . He/She is … and has … .
I’m … . It’s okay / I want to be … .
This person is … . He/She has … hair. Who is it?
I think … is more important because … .
I think … is very good-looking. He/She has … .
My hair is … and … . I like / don’t like it.
samples: Describe yourself — what do you look like? What color is your hair and eyes?
I’m **short** and **thin**. My hair is **long** and **black**. My eyes are **very dark**.
Describe your best friend. What does he or she look like?
My best friend is **Laylo**. She is **very cute**. She has **curly brown** hair.
Is your hair straight or curly? Long or short? Do you like your hair?
My hair is **straight** and **short**. I like it. It’s **very** easy!

game.title: Guess who!
game.rules: Read a card. Your partner guesses: “Is it Ali or Bobur?” Then swap!
items: I’m a boy. I have short black hair and brown eyes.
I’m a girl. I have very long straight hair.
I’m tall and strong. I play football every day.
I’m a girl. I have curly hair and big blue eyes.
I’m short and very cute. I wear red glasses.
I’m a teacher. I have grey hair and a big smile.

mini_talk.title: My best friend
plan: Say why you like him or her
mini_talk.model: This is my best friend, **Bobur**. He is twelve. He is **very tall** and **strong**. He has **short black** hair and **brown** eyes. He is **funny** and **kind**. We play football after school. I like him because he is **very** friendly!

cando: ask questions with What color and or
